# Denner

Verified rental flats in Pune, India — move in with trust, not tension.

> Denner (https://mydenner.com) is a Pune-focused property-rental platform for finding flats to rent. Every listing is verified, costs are transparent, and renting is low-to-no brokerage — connecting renters directly with verified owners and partners. Denner covers Pune's major residential and IT-corridor neighbourhoods, with typical 2026 rents of roughly ₹12,000–₹22,000 for a 1 BHK, ₹18,000–₹40,000 for a 2 BHK, and ₹30,000–₹65,000 for a 3 BHK per month, depending on area and furnishing.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://mydenner.com/): What Denner is and how it works.
- [Browse flats](https://mydenner.com/properties): Search verified rental flats in Pune by area, BHK, budget and furnishing.
- [FAQ](https://mydenner.com/faq): Common questions on renting in Pune — verified listings, rents, deposits, brokerage, documents and visits.
- [Pune renting guide](https://mydenner.com/guide): The complete 2026 guide to renting a flat in Pune, with area-by-area rent ranges, deposits and the renting process in Maharashtra.
